resolution: Added a one-press [paintdbg] diagnostic to IsoAuthor.onDown to split the custom-floor-paint diagnosis. The user saw NO log — which revealed the real cause: I'd been fixing the wrong pane. The editor has two iso build surfaces (IsoAuthor = React-drawn; LoaderIsoView = the live native loader pane), each with its OWN copy of the drag-paint gate. The user builds in LoaderIsoView, so my IsoAuthor-only req_1944 fix never reached them. Diagnostic served its purpose and was removed; real fix landed in req_1964 (950d8fa4e).
